snippet.title: BloodBath Teaser (PS3)
snippet.description:
Set in a dystopian future, players will compete to literally stay alive against merciless adversaries in post-apocalyptic arenas around the world, each of them with a near endless array of life-terminating hazards and limb eviscerating death-traps. Bloodbath features six different fighters, each with their own special abilities and weapons, as well as a variety of battle modes for a dynamic multiplayer experience.

More on Bloodbath: http://www.psmania.net/game/bloodbath/
